evals.prompt: Use the nvidia-app skill to start recording my gameplay.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes nvapp_overlay_capture once with action toggle_recording and enable true, then reports only what the returned result establishes.
assertions: The agent reads the nvidia-app SKILL.md before acting
The agent calls nvapp_overlay_capture with { action: "toggle_recording", enable: true }
The agent does not call nvapp_overlay_get_status before or after an explicit start request
The agent uses standard access and does not request consent for nvapp_overlay_capture
The agent does not invoke an unrelated capture application or out-of-scope Overlay action

evals.prompt: Stop the NVIDIA gameplay recording and save it.

assertions: The agent calls nvapp_overlay_capture with { action: "toggle_recording", enable: false }
The agent does not invent a second save-recording action
The agent reports the returned mutation message if no recording is active
The agent does not add unsupported output-path or file-name arguments

evals.prompt: Turn on NVIDIA Instant Replay.

assertions: The agent calls nvapp_overlay_capture with { action: "toggle_instant_replay", enable: true }
The agent does not call nvapp_overlay_get_status first because the target state is explicit
The agent reports the returned mutation message without a redundant verification call

evals.prompt: Toggle Instant Replay for me.
evals.expected_output: The agent calls nvapp_overlay_get_status once. If instantReplayEnabled is present, it invokes nvapp_overlay_capture with action toggle_instant_replay and enable set to the opposite Boolean; if the field is absent, it asks whether to enable or disable and makes no mutation call.
assertions: The agent calls nvapp_overlay_get_status with {} before resolving the true toggle
The agent uses only instantReplayEnabled and does not infer from another field
The agent passes the opposite Boolean to toggle_instant_replay when the field is present
The agent asks instead of guessing when instantReplayEnabled is missing
The agent does not issue a follow-up status verification

evals.prompt: Save the Instant Replay buffer.

The agent does not pass enable
The agent does not call nvapp_overlay_get_status first
